inputs.text: [excited][playful] Here we are in the [serious] age of mammals! [happily] The sky clears up. The weather turns mild again. The forests grow back.
[playful][happily] Warm and humid, like a big greenhouse. [softly] The mammals were hiding under the dinosaurs' feet. Now they can finally grow.
[excited][quickly] Huge! [shouts] Smilodon, the saber-toothed cat! [happily] A giant sloth, big as an elephant. [gasps] And a giant snake, Titanoboa, over forty feet long!
[gasps][excited] As long as a house! [playful] And some mammals go back to live in the water: whales and dolphins. [softly] Their babies drink milk… [pauses] underwater.
[chuckles][warmly] Milk underwater. [softly] Mama whale feeds her baby while she swims, [pauses] just like every mammal mom.
[excited] Time goes by. [playful] Then, [pauses] the cold comes back. [serious] Really cold, colder and colder.
